# 字体文件目录

此目录用于存放本地备用字体文件。

## 文件说明

- `opensans-300-latin.woff2` - Open Sans 300权重字体
- `opensans-400-latin.woff2` - Open Sans 400权重字体  
- `opensans-600-latin.woff2` - Open Sans 600权重字体
- `opensans-700-latin.woff2` - Open Sans 700权重字体

## 下载说明

如需完整的字体文件，可以从以下URL下载：

```bash
# 300权重
curl -o opensans-300-latin.woff2 "https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/opensans/v44/memvYaGs126MiZpBA-UvWbX2vVnXBbObj2OVTS-muw.woff2"

# 400权重  
curl -o opensans-400-latin.woff2 "https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/opensans/v44/memvYaGs126MiZpBA-UvWbX2vVnXBbObj2OVTS-muw.woff2"

# 600权重
curl -o opensans-600-latin.woff2 "https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/opensans/v44/memSYaGs126MiZpBA-UvWbX2vVnXBbObj2OVZyOOSr4dVJWUgsgH1x4gaVI.woff2"

# 700权重
curl -o opensans-700-latin.woff2 "https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/opensans/v44/memSYaGs126MiZpBA-UvWbX2vVnXBbObj2OVZyOOSr4dVJWUgsgH1x4gaVI.woff2"
```

字体文件会自动回退到系统字体，确保网站正常显示。
